author_or_institution: Edoardo Debenedetti; Jie Zhang; Mislav Balunovic; Luca Beurer-Kellner; Marc Fischer; Florian Tramer
title: AgentDojo: A Dynamic Environment to Evaluate Prompt Injection Attacks and Defenses for LLM Agents
book_use: Provides a dynamic benchmark for tool-using agents operating over untrusted data, with 97 realistic tasks and 629 security test cases spanning email, banking, travel, and related workflows; establishes indirect prompt injection as an agent-system problem rather than a chat-only problem.
